data.name: Nadeen
data.gender_notes: Nadeen is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'nadon', meaning 'comfort' or 'consolation'. In Christian tradition, the name Nadeen is associated with the gentle and nurturing nature of Mary, the mother of Jesus. The name Nadeen carries the meaning “Comforting, gentle, and sweet” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nadeen usually hope their child will grow to embody comforting, gentle, and sweet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of comfort and nurturing love.
data.etymology: Nadeen belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Comforting, gentle, and sweet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nadeen total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: נאדין
in_hebrew.meaning: מתנת אלוהים, נחמה אלוהית, שמחה אלוהית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם נאדין הוא שילוב של המילים 'נאד' שפירושה מתנה ו'אלוהים' שפירושה אלוהים. הוא קשור לנחמה אלוהית ושמחה אלוהית. השם נאדין משויך למסורת היהודית והוא נמצא בשימוש גם בקרב הנוצרים.

in_greek.name: Ναδείν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ναδείν είναι μια μορφή του ονόματος Ναδινή, που σημαίνει 'χαριτωμένο από τον Θεό' ή 'δώρο του Θεού'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με την έννοια της θείας εύνοιας και της πνευματικής χαράς.

in_latin.name: Nadeen
in_latin.meaning: Donum Dei, Gratia Dei, Laetitia Divina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Nadeen originem habet in voce 'donum', quod 'donum Dei' seu 'gratia Dei' significat. In traditione christiana, nomen hoc ad notionem munificentiae divinae et laetitiae spiritualis pertinet.
